svg.text: quote(carId, period): BigDecimal — price without booking
pickUp(resId, at) · returnCar(resId, at): Charges · cancel(resId)
overlap scan + insert run inside ONE per-car lock
threads on different cars never contend — no global mutex ✓
availability is DERIVED — a Car has no RENTED flag
CarStatus is fleet admin (MAINTENANCE / RETIRED), not booking state
honest: no service interface — the facade is the only entry point
Car: id, plate, type, homeLocation, status
only ACTIVE cars are searchable — status gates supply, not booking
baseCost: BigDecimal — frozen at reserve time
isActive(): boolean — drives the overlap scan
TWO STRATEGY AXES — each wrapped by a DECORATOR
bills only N days per 7 — long-rental discount
quote() and reserve() both go through this
runs ONLY at return — scheduled vs actual
so a mid-rental tariff change can't move the base quote
second axis, varies independently of pricing
same shape as GracePeriodLateFeePolicy on the other axis
2 base rules × 2 wrappers = 4 behaviours from 4 classes,
honest: both are console printers, not real channels
COW list ⇒ notify without holding the car lock
THE STATE PATTERN — the legal-transition matrix as types
co-located with the entity in model/ — the
lifecycle is domain logic, not service logic
stateless singletons, safe to share across threads
no NO_SHOW here — unlike the hotel model
cancel instantly frees the car — no row deleted,
no flag flipped, the scan just stops seeing it
Reservation delegates pickUp / returnCar / cancel to its ReservationState

g.text: baseCost is computed ONCE, at reserve,
and stored on the Reservation. The late
fee is computed ONCE, at return, from
Charges keeps them separate so a receipt
intent — that is exactly why seasonal
surge is a wrapper, not a 3rd base rule.
Name both in the interview; it lands.

svg.text: ① CarRental facade (maps + per-car locks) → ② model: Car/CarType, Reservation, DateRange, Charges → ③ two Strategy axes + their Decorators + Observer → ④ ReservationState × 4 and isActive()

g.text: Patterns: Facade · State · Strategy × 2 · Decorator × 2 · Observer · Value Object
Date-range car rental — per-car locks, derived availability, late fees — LLD
